components.name: ResponsiveTooltip
components.description: One hint, two forms: a tooltip on hover for mouse and trackpad, and a popover on tap for touch, where a hover tooltip can't open.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text of the default trigger button.

props.name: content
props.description: What the hint says: the tooltip's text and the popover's body.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the content, shown in the popover only.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut after the tooltip text. Hidden in the popover.

props.name: mode
props.description: `auto` shows a hover tooltip on devices that can hover and a tap popover on touch devices. `tooltip` and `popover` force one.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Tooltip open delay in ms. Defaults to the provider's (200).

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Must accept a ref and props, e.g. a button.

examples.title: auto · hover on desktop, tap on mobile
examples.code:
<ResponsiveTooltip
  label="Hover or tap"
  title="Responsive"
  content="A tooltip where the pointer can hover, a popover on touch."
/>

examples.title: tone danger
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" align="center">
  <ResponsiveTooltip
    label="Job number"
    title="Required"
    content="Job number is required."
    tone="danger"
  />
  <ResponsiveTooltip
    mode="popover"
    label="Job number · popover"
    title="Required"
    content="Job number is required."
    tone="danger"
  />
</Stack>

examples.title: custom trigger · shortcut
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" align="center">
  <ResponsiveTooltip content="Save the draft" shortcut="Ctrl S">
    <Button tone="outline" size="sm">
      Save
    </Button>
  </ResponsiveTooltip>
  <ResponsiveTooltip
    side="right"
    title="Billing cycle"
    content="Charges renew on the first of each month."
  >
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label="About billing cycle"
      className="inline-flex rounded-full p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
    >
      <InfoIcon className="size-4" />
    </button>
  </ResponsiveTooltip>
</Stack>

examples.title: mode tooltip / popover
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" align="center">
  <ResponsiveTooltip
    mode="tooltip"
    label="Tooltip"
    content="Always a hover tooltip."
  />
  <ResponsiveTooltip
    mode="popover"
    label="Popover"
    title="Popover"
    content="Always a tap popover, as a phone sees it."
  />
</Stack>
